verdict.rationale: Installed plugins bring user data from Slack, Gmail, Drive/Docs/Sheets, and Notion into ChatGPT/Codex, where the agent works on it. Examples include summarizing Slack channels, drafting replies, and scanning code to confirm vulnerability findings. A community user also describes querying analytics through a Metabase skill. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of analytical insight or recommendation features beyond one-line plugin descriptions, and independent hands-on corroboration that insights are high quality (the community evidence covers only a single analytics skill).
